newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen climbing higher on PPI data.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen climbing higher on PPI data.

text.p: The Dow industrials are likely to rise Friday, extending their recent record-setting run, analysts said.
Weaker-than-expected Producer Price Index data for May will prod the Dow higher, following its 136-point surge to 7711 on Thursday, the analysts said.
PPI fell 0.3 percent, furthering convincing investors that the Federal Reserve will not raise interest rates. Wall Street economists had expected a 0.1 percent increase.
Michael Metz, chief investment strategist at Oppenheimer & Co, said the data were "more disinflationary than expected."
